limitations: The injected sweep exercises the direct record writer. It does not inject failures across the whole-file adapter transaction or prove destination-file rollback for this class.
Retries use a fresh low-level writer because the failed writer may contain partial stream bytes and its write error is sticky.

Only the bounded VisibilityParameter candidate and existing PurgePreventer profile are covered. Physical producer/schema breadth, complete graph qualification, other dynamic-block variants, and native consumer behavior remain open.
The test authors all control records in memory; no DWG/DXF fixture is added and no support claim is promoted.
